~~~{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/widgets/refraction_labs.css">
<div class="refraction-layers-lab" data-refraction-layers
     role="group" aria-label="Phase of a light wave in a transparent layer">
  <div class="refraction-layers-lab__controls">
    <label>Refractive index
      <span data-index-value>1.08</span>
      <input type="range" data-index min="1" max="1.2" step="0.005" value="1.08">
    </label>
    <label>Layer thickness, \(L/\lambda_0\)
      <span data-length-value>1.50</span>
      <input type="range" data-length min="0.05" max="3" step="0.05" value="1.5">
    </label>
  </div>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 395" role="img"
       aria-label="Wave transmitted through the layer compared with the wave in vacuum">
    <rect class="refraction-layers-lab__medium" x="285" y="35" width="630" height="260"></rect>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__axis" x1="70" y1="165" x2="1130" y2="165"></line>
    <path class="refraction-layers-lab__vacuum" data-vacuum-wave></path>
    <path class="refraction-layers-lab__wave" data-medium-wave></path>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__boundary" x1="285" y1="35" x2="285" y2="295"></line>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__boundary" x1="915" y1="35" x2="915" y2="295"></line>
    <text x="125" y="335">vacuum</text>
    <text x="555" y="335">medium</text>
    <text x="962" y="335">vacuum</text>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__key-vacuum" x1="360" y1="370" x2="410" y2="370"></line>
    <text x="424" y="377">no layer</text>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__key-medium" x1="680" y1="370" x2="730" y2="370"></line>
    <text x="744" y="377">with layer</text>
  </svg>
  <p class="refraction-layers-lab__readout" aria-live="polite">
    Extra phase at the exit:
    <span data-phase-value>0.75</span> rad.
    The frequency is the same on both sides of the layer.
  </p>
</div>
<script defer src="assets/widgets/refraction_labs.js"></script>
~~~
